notes.title: The thousand years
notes.intro: John sees Satan bound and the faithful reigning with Christ for a thousand years.

views.label: A symbol of Christ’s present reign (amillennial)
views.summary: Catholic, Orthodox, Lutheran, Reformed and many others read the thousand years as symbolic of the present age between Christ’s first and second comings.
views.source: Catechism of the Catholic Church 676; Augsburg Confession, Article XVII

views.label: A future reign of Christ on earth (premillennial)
views.summary: Many Pentecostals and evangelicals expect Christ to return and reign on earth for a literal thousand years.
views.source: Assemblies of God, Statement of Fundamental Truths, 14

views.label: The saints reign in heaven while the earth lies desolate
views.summary: Seventh-day Adventists teach that during the thousand years the redeemed are in heaven and the earth is empty, before final judgement.

notes.common: All agree Christ will return and defeat evil for good.
